proposals.current_spec: When connected, each entry in batch_lookup MUST produce a log message via the ILogger receptacle
proposals.current_code: Logging is unconditional — no connection state exists
proposals.proposed_text: Each entry in `batch_lookup` MUST produce a log message via the `ILogger` receptacle (placeholder behavior). If the ILogger receptacle is not bound, logging is silently skipped.

proposals.current_spec: When not connected, batch_lookup MUST return Err(RemoteLookupError::NotConnected) for every entry
proposals.current_code: NotConnected variant removed. No connection state.
proposals.proposed_text: The `batch_lookup` method MUST be callable at any time after component instantiation. No connection precondition is required.

proposals.current_spec: Component MUST expose functionality only through the IRemoteLookup interface
proposals.current_code: join_cluster and leave_cluster are interface methods (compliant)

proposals.proposed_text: The `IRemoteLookup` interface MUST expose a `join_cluster` method with signature `fn join_cluster(&self, endpoint: &str) -> Result<(), RemoteLookupError>`. The placeholder implementation MUST log the endpoint and return `Ok(())`.

The `IRemoteLookup` interface MUST expose a `leave_cluster` method with signature `fn leave_cluster(&self) -> Result<(), RemoteLookupError>`. The placeholder implementation MUST log the call and return `Ok(())`.
